about.heading: A country vet Cortland can count on
about.lead: We're a down-to-earth clinic where pets and farm animals get gentle hands, honest advice, and care that feels like it's coming from a neighbor.
paragraphs: Cortland Animal Hospital sits right on West Lincoln Highway, caring for the dogs and cats on your porch and the animals out in the field. Whether it's a first puppy visit, a worrisome cough, or a herd that needs a once-over, we take the time to explain your options in plain language.

Country life moves with the seasons, and so do we. We're happy to see you in the clinic or load up the truck for a ranch call — whatever keeps your animals healthy, comfortable, and working alongside you for years to come.

process.heading: What to Expect at Cortland Animal Hospital

steps.title: Book Your Visit
steps.text: Request a time online, and tell us about your animal — we'll set up a clinic visit or a ranch call.

steps.title: Gentle Exam
steps.text: We take our time with a calm, nose-to-tail check, asking about diet, age, and anything that's been worrying you.

steps.title: Honest Diagnosis & Plan
steps.text: We explain what we find in plain language and lay out fair, practical options for your pet or your herd.

steps.title: Follow-Up Care
steps.text: We send you home with clear aftercare and stay in reach to check progress and answer any questions.

items.q: Do you take walk-ins or do I need an appointment?
items.a: We work best by appointment so we can give each animal real attention. For a sick pet or urgent concern, message us and we'll do our best to fit you in.

items.q: Do you really come out to the farm or ranch?
items.a: Yes. We load up the truck for on-site visits to horses, cattle, sheep, and goats — routine herd work, sick animals, and seasonal care right at your place.

items.q: How much will my visit cost?
items.a: Many services start at a posted price, while others depend on your animal's needs. We'll talk through honest options upfront, with no upselling and no surprises.

items.q: What should I bring to my first visit?
items.a: Bring any past records, vaccine history, and a list of current foods or medications. For nervous pets, a leash or carrier helps keep the visit calm.
We're glad to help Spanish-speaking neighbors and will do our best to make sure you fully understand your animal's care and options.
We're open Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:30 PM, and Saturday from 8:00 AM to noon. We're closed Sundays.

process.heading: Qué Esperar en Cortland Animal Hospital

steps.title: Agenda Tu Visita
steps.text: Pide una cita en línea y cuéntanos sobre tu animal — coordinamos una visita a la clínica o al rancho.

steps.title: Examen Gentil
steps.text: Nos tomamos el tiempo con una revisión tranquila de la nariz a la cola, preguntando sobre dieta, edad y lo que te preocupa.

steps.title: Diagnóstico y Plan Honestos
steps.text: Explicamos lo que encontramos en palabras claras y te damos opciones justas y prácticas para tu mascota o tu rebaño.

steps.title: Cuidado de Seguimiento
steps.text: Te enviamos a casa con cuidados claros y seguimos a tu alcance para revisar el progreso y responder tus preguntas.

items.a: Trabajamos mejor con cita para darle atención real a cada animal. Si tu mascota está enferma o es urgente, escríbenos y haremos lo posible por recibirte.

items.q: ¿De verdad van a la granja o al rancho?
items.a: Sí. Cargamos la camioneta para visitas en el lugar a caballos, vacas, ovejas y cabras — trabajo de rutina, animales enfermos y cuidado de temporada en tu propiedad.
Muchos servicios tienen un precio inicial publicado y otros dependen de las necesidades de tu animal. Hablamos de opciones honestas de antemano, sin ventas de más ni sorpresas.

items.q: ¿Qué debo llevar a mi primera visita?
items.a: Trae registros previos, historial de vacunas y una lista de alimentos o medicamentos actuales. Para mascotas nerviosas, una correa o transportadora ayuda a mantener la calma.
Con gusto atendemos a nuestros vecinos de habla hispana y haremos lo posible para que entiendas bien el cuidado y las opciones de tu animal.
Abrimos de lunes a viernes, de 8:00 AM a 5:30 PM, y los sábados de 8:00 AM al mediodía. Cerramos los domingos.
